What is the standard Japanese pitch accent pattern of 「弟」?

Answer Choices:
A. Heiban
B. Atamadaka
C. Nakadaka
D. Odaka
E. Heiban or Nakadaka

This is consistent with how similar kinship terms like 「姉」 or 「妹」 are often accented in dictionaries.
